static_review.assertion: A new normalized private run directory, exact contract/recipe/tool/source bindings, current protected state, installed prefix/SDK checks and exact PASS review/admission hashes gate execution. Failure and preservation checks propagate through the outer report.

Existing default/named-profile parity, frozen native/source-state contracts, canonical shared lease and fresh capacity/guard checks are retained. Final preservation errors mark FAIL and propagate. These native paths were not executed by this reviewer.

The original IWYU and LLVM resource trees are copied only into the fresh private staging tree, checked by the existing inventory contract, then renamed to a moved sibling. The original roots are not renamed. Staging absence and moved/fixture preservation are checked at completion.

The moved binary is hash/ARM64 checked. Version output and dyld evidence must identify the moved executable, fixed private libclang-cpp/LLVM and system libc++; original IWYU/staging origins and the product LLVM libc++ path are rejected. Exact default/explicit resource queries retain their expected nonzero result semantics.

The pinned no-standard-include witness retains Clang builtins and traces system headers with -H. Each actual trace path must be canonical and inside copied resources, match an inventory digest and include stddef.h plus __stddef_size_t.h. The empty-resource control changes only the resource operand and requires exit 1 with the missing-stddef diagnostic. Clean reflection analysis uses the moved executable and explicit copied resource root.
Preparation and pending native verification are distinguished. Original LLVM stays fixed; this unit does not claim LLVM relocation or automatic moved-resource discovery.
